examples.en: Detaining and ticketing such drivers is not the purpose of the roadblock and would unduly slow down the stops of other cars.
examples.zh: 拘留和对这类司机开罚单不是设置路障的目的，而且会使其他车辆过度减速。

examples.en: His car was swerved to avoid bumping against the roadblock.
examples.zh: 为了避免撞上路障，他把车作了个急转弯。
